lines.text: Thanks for calling Willow and Pine, this is Ava. How can I help?
Hi, um, yeah. I was wondering if you had anything open for a HydraFacial this week?
Oh, for sure. Let me take a look. Okay, I've got Thursday at two thirty, or Friday morning at ten. Do either of those work?
Thursday at two thirty is perfect.
Great. And can I get your first and last name?

tool.r: Held while we finish the call

lines.text: Thanks, Ryan. Is this the best number to text your confirmation to?
Perfect. So that's a HydraFacial, Thursday at two thirty. It's a hundred and ninety nine, and it takes about an hour. You'll get a text in just a second, and a reminder the day before.
Okay, awesome. Thank you so much.

tool.r: You're booked Thu 2:30pm at Willow & Pine. Reply C to cancel.

lines.text: Of course! See you Thursday, Ryan.

tool.r: New client, HydraFacial booked, CRM contact created
